figures.label: S15
figures.caption: Figure S15. Li7NMR spectra comparison of composite cathodes based on NCM@LNO treated at 300oC, 600oC and 850oC. Description: Li7NMR was carried out to access the spontaneous lithium-ion transport between the NCM@LNO cathode and LPSC electrolyte39. The width of the peak represents the capability of Li+ transfer across the interface, where SCL should be dominant.[6] The detailed results of the LNO modified samples are compared in Figure S15, and NCM@LNO-600 sample delivers the widest peak among them, which discloses that the lithium-ion exchange rate of NCM@LNO-600 sample exhibits a little higher than that of NCM@LNO-300 and NCM@LNO-850 samples.
